description: This file defines the Errors class, which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's Conditional Formatting Wizard components. It provides methods for creating and evaluating conditional formatting rules related to error detection in spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: Errors
classes.description: A class for managing conditional formatting rules that detect errors in spreadsheet cells, providing methods to generate conditions such as 'is error' and 'not error'. It extends WizardAbstract and implements WizardInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Errors wizard with a cell range and optional inverse flag.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Sets whether the error check should be inverted.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Generates the conditional expression based on the current state, particularly the inverse flag.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Builds and returns a Conditional object representing the error checking rule.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates an Errors wizard instance from an existing Conditional object.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Dynamically handles method calls, enabling usage of 'notError' and 'isError' to set the inverse flag.
